description: The 'domain' parameter on /lab1 allows remote command injection when passed to a system shell command without sanitization.
solution: Avoid executing commands via shell=True; use argument vectors with subprocess.run and strict input validation.

description: The 'val' parameter on /lab2 is directly evaluated using python eval() allowing arbitrary code execution.
solution: Avoid using eval() or exec() with untrusted user input.

description: SQL Injection detected on the /lab login form through the 'username' field.
solution: Use parameterized queries or ORM queries instead of string formatting.

description: Content Security Policy (CSP) is not configured on the web application.
